description: BTC MetaFilter V1 — Stage 2 P(TP|signal) filter. 47 PiT meta-features (37 btc_macro_enhanced + 10 PiT meta). Trained on 3,532 btc_swing signals from phase5b dataset (2,333 TP / 1,199 SL). Stage 1: LGB-Huber OOF PiT CV. Stage 2: LGB binary classifier (210 rounds, val WR 70.9%). Platt calibrated.
